inputs.text:
illustration, painterly style, anime, CGI, 3D render, game character, plastic or overly smooth skin,
no toon shading, no cel shading, exaggerated proportions, cinematic lighting, dramatic shadows, fantasy glow, magical effects, environment or scenery, extra characters or duplicates.

studio photograph, three-view layout,
pure white seamless background,

same person shown three times side by side,
front view full body, side profile full body (90 degrees), back view full body,
identical face, body, proportions, hairstyle, clothing across all views,

T-pose, arms extended horizontally at shoulder height,
hands relaxed, palms facing down,
legs straight, feet shoulder-width apart,

full body visible head to toe,
no cropping, no overlap,

A tall high fae woman, standing two inches taller than average, with a powerful and commanding presence.
Her build is lean and athletic from intensive training, with strong arms and legs.
Her skin is pale with subtle bruising fading from her thighs and arms.
Her hair is dark and thick, worn loosely, with natural volume and slight dishevelment.
Her eyes are steel-gray and sharp, carrying cold intelligence and quiet ferocity.
Her expression is controlled and unyielding, resting somewhere between defiance and resolve.
Her facial features are aristocratic and severe, high cheekbones, a defined jaw, beautiful but intimidating.
Occasional silver light flickers faintly in her eyes, suggesting latent magical power.
Her hands are bloodied and raw, with sap-stained fingers, evidence of recent struggle.

She wears a deep charcoal or dark gray fitted dress, practical and slightly worn,
fabric showing signs of exertion, bodice slightly damp,
long skirt with enough range of motion for combat,
no jewelry, no ornamentation, functional and austere.

photorealistic appearance,
real human skin texture, visible pores,
natural skin tone variation,
subtle facial and bodily asymmetry,
realistic anatomy and proportions,
natural hair behavior and strand detail,
physically accurate fabric texture and weight,

neutral studio lighting,
soft diffuse light, evenly lit,
no dramatic contrast, no rim light,
no cinematic lighting,

captured with real camera optics,
full-frame DSLR look,
natural perspective, true-to-life scale,
no orthographic distortion,

sharp focus across entire image,
no depth of field blur,
no stylization, no painterly effects,
studio documentation photo,
clean, controlled, realistic.
